Short description:
Here will be described basics of Github with the short example analysis of the given tables 


#Git Basics

##Exercise 7
```{r}
library(readr)
cytotox <- read_csv("cytotox.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
mosaicplot(~Element+Cell_type,
           data=cytotox,
           col=c("blue", "green"),
           ylab = "Cell type",
           xlab = "Type of nanoparticle",
           las = 2,
           cex.axis = 0.6
           )
```
